entities.summary: Frank Joseph Herrmann, is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Cleveland Indians and Philadelphia Phillies, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Tohoku Rakuten Golden Eagles and Chiba Lotte Marines.
